A single closed flush ivory-painted interior door with concealed frame integrated in a warm light-grey plaster wall in a minimalist premium apartment. The very fine straight shadow-gap reveals make its rectangular outline obvious, precise flush alignment, matte black simple lever handle, tiny black key escutcheon beneath. Camera at eye level, slightly diagonal across wall, door placed slightly right of center with gentle raking daylight from left emphasizing the fitted edge, only a narrow strip of light stone floor at bottom. Contemporary quiet architectural luxury, tactile real painted surface. Entire doorway visible with breathing room. No oak door leaves, no decorative mouldings, no double doors, no people, no impossible floating handle.
